evidence.quote: may not fully account for the variety of viable strategies to accomplish a task

evidence.quote: extracts the interactive elements based on web element types and then overlays bounding boxes with numerical labels

evidence.quote: choose to believe the content.
evidence.support_explanation: Visually transcribed continuous prompt text: if response content is absent from screenshot, judge is told to believe it. This permits unsupported response assertions, unlike a pure visual completion verifier.

claims.text: WebVoyager autonomously completes live public-web tasks end-to-end and outperforms text-only/AllTools baselines.
claims.setting: 643 tasks,15 sites; non-login, single-tab,15steps; GPT4visionpreview primary backbone
claims.baseline_control: Text-only GPT4 accessibility tree; GPT4AllTools distinct Bing/search/tool interface, not clean architectural intervention
claims.selection_vs_test: Task set synthesized from seeds and human checked; no explicit held-out-site split for prompt development
claims.allowed_conclusion: Author-reported real execution success on this bounded task/site sample; not universal reliable web automation or isolated visual-interface causal gain.

claims.text: GPT4V can evaluate agent completion with human-level-consistent scalable automatic assessment.
claims.setting: 300-task human-calibration subset; vary last-k screenshots to full trajectory; temperature0
claims.baseline_control: Consolidated human labels; human pre-discussion Fleiss kappa .7; multiple actor/judge model matrix
claims.selection_vs_test: Calibration subset not established independent of prompt/model choices; evaluation on other models still uses same selected task set

result.denominator: 300 calibration tasks;643 overall tasks;3 repeated evaluator calls per automatic evaluation, not3agent runs

claims.allowed_conclusion: Substantial agreement with humans on sampled trajectories, not unbiased universal success oracle; human59.1% must not be replaced by auto57.1%. The prompt accepts response content absent from screenshots, so it is not independent visual verification of every answer.

claims.text: Generalization beyond main benchmark to additional settings.
claims.baseline_control: Different tasks/evaluation protocols; no fixed shared unseen-category design
claims.selection_vs_test: Additional subsets, not audit of foundational model contamination
claims.allowed_conclusion: Additional author-reported tests/examples only; do not infer broad transfer from unverified plotted numbers or anecdotes.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported human-judged live-browser task completion on643selected public-web tasks (59.1%, versus40.1%text-only), plus substantial GPT4V judge agreement on300sampled trajectories. Not pixel-only, not universal reliability, and not isolated architectural causality.
